info.name: Geofencing & Real-time Alert API
info.description:
All routes of the geofencing API with tests. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner): later requests reuse ids saved by earlier ones.

Variables: baseUrl (default http://localhost:8080) and apiKey (leave empty unless API_KEY is set on the server).

WebSocket alerts: Postman -> New -> WebSocket -> ws://localhost:8080/ws/alerts (add ?api_key=... if the server uses an API key), click Connect, then run folder 4.

exec: // Shift every coordinate by a per-run offset so each run uses its own area and never overlaps zones left by earlier runs.
pm.test('returns id, name and status active', () => { pm.expect(j.id).to.match(/^geo_/); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('active'); });
// Shift every coordinate by a per-run offset so each run uses its own area and never overlaps zones left by earlier runs.

pm.test('has geofences array with required fields', () => { pm.expect(j.geofences).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; ['id','name','description','coordinates','category','created_at'].forEach(k => pm.expect(j.geofences[0]).to.have.property(k)); });
pm.test('only restricted_zone returned', () => { const g = pm.response.json().geofences; pm.expect(g).to.not.be.empty; g.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.category).to.eql('restricted_zone')); });
pm.test('one item and total_count present', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.geofences).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.total_count).to.be.at.least(1); });

pm.test('returns id, vehicle_number, status active', () => { pm.expect(j.id).to.match(/^veh_/); pm.expect(j.vehicle_number).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('vehicleNumber')); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('active'); });

pm.test('contains the registered vehicle', () => { const v = pm.response.json().vehicles; pm.expect(v.map(x => x.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('vehicleId')); ['id','vehicle_number','driver_name','vehicle_type','phone','status','created_at'].forEach(k => pm.expect(v[0]).to.have.property(k)); });

item.name: 3.1 Configure alert (restricted zone, both, all vehicles)

exec: pm.test('rule created for all vehicles', () => { pm.expect(j.alert_id).to.match(/^alert_/); pm.expect(j.vehicle_id).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.event_type).to.eql('both'); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('active'); });
pm.test('rule is scoped to the vehicle', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().vehicle_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('vehicleId')));

pm.test('rules include names', () => { const a = pm.response.json().alerts; pm.expect(a.length).to.be.at.least(2); ['alert_id','geofence_id','geofence_name','vehicle_id','vehicle_number','event_type','status','created_at'].forEach(k => pm.expect(a[0]).to.have.property(k)); });

item.name: 3.4 List alert rules filtered by geofence_id

exec: pm.test('only rules of that geofence', () => pm.response.json().alerts.forEach(a => pm.expect(a.geofence_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('geofenceId'))));

item.name: 3.5 List alert rules filtered by vehicle_id

exec: pm.test('only rules of that vehicle', () => { const a = pm.response.json().alerts; pm.expect(a).to.not.be.empty; a.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.vehicle_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('vehicleId'))); });

request.description: Vehicle starts outside the restricted zone. No event is generated.

request.description: Triggers an ENTRY event. If you are connected to ws://localhost:8080/ws/alerts you will see the alert arrive.

item.name: 4.3 Get current location of the vehicle
4.4 Update location - LEAVE restricted zone (alert is pushed)
4.5 Update location - ENTER delivery zone (vehicle-specific rule)
4.6 List latest location of all vehicles (extra)

exec: pm.test('lists our vehicle with its geofences', () => { const l = pm.response.json().locations.find(x => x.vehicle_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('vehicleId')); pm.expect(l).to.exist; pm.expect(l.current_geofences).to.have.length(1); });

pm.test('has entry, exit, entry events with total_count', () => { pm.expect(j.total_count).to.be.at.least(3); ['id','vehicle_id','vehicle_number','geofence_id','geofence_name','event_type','latitude','longitude','timestamp'].forEach(k => pm.expect(j.violations[0]).to.have.property(k)); });
pm.test('newest first', () => { const t = j.violations.map(v => Date.parse(v.timestamp)); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });

item.name: 5.2 Violation history filtered by vehicle_id + limit

exec: pm.test('only this vehicle, exactly 3 events', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.violations).to.have.length(3); j.violations.forEach(v => pm.expect(v.vehicle_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('vehicleId'))); pm.expect(j.violations.map(v => v.event_type)).to.eql(['entry', 'exit', 'entry']); });
pm.test('second page has 1 row, total_count is 3', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.violations).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.total_count).to.eql(3); });

pm.test('alerts were generated for entry and exit', () => { const e = pm.response.json().events; pm.expect(e.length).to.be.at.least(3); const types = e.slice(0, 3).map(x => x.event_type); pm.expect(types).to.include.members(['entry', 'exit']); ['event_id','event_type','timestamp','vehicle','geofence','location'].forEach(k => pm.expect(e[0]).to.have.property(k)); });
